SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Country = 'Czech Republic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Country = 'Slovakia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Difference 
FROM gasstations AS T1 
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.ChainID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'discount'
